The quickstarts include tested versions in some pages, but the documentdb-driver skill doesn't prescribe a single pinned version in code templates. Looked in: documentdb-driver skill, quickstarts discovered via docs search; quickstart pages show tested driver versions but the agent kit guidance lacks a canonical pin. Effect: The sample's requirements.txt uses ranges (pymongo>=4.4). Consumers and CI users benefit from pinned versions for reproducible installs; the builder had to pick a version without a single authoritative recommendation.
proposed_change: [learn_doc] Add a brief 'Tested driver versions' section to the documentdb-driver skill and the quickstart templates showing exact pip pins for a stable reference (e.g., 'This sample was tested with PyMongo==4.19.0; pin that in requirements.txt or supply a constraints file for reproducible installs').

topic: Microsoft Entra ID examples for data-plane auth
detail: Missing: A short, copy-paste example showing how to configure Microsoft Entra ID / MONGODB-OIDC authentication in PyMongo (or how to use azure-identity for managed identities) targeted at sample authors. Looked in: documentdb-security and connection skills; docs mention Entra ID support but example code snippets for the driver were limited or scattered. Effect: The author defaulted to connection-string auth and did not document Entra ID usage. Authors and sample readers may assume Entra ID is unavailable or may not know how to wire it into the driver.
proposed_change: [discoverability] Add a short 'Using Microsoft Entra ID for data-plane' subsection in the documentdb-connection skill with a PyMongo example, environment variables needed, and when the sample should use Entra vs connection-string (and include a link to the portal setting to enable Entra ID on the cluster).

topic: Guidance for retry/backoff for demo code
detail: Missing: A tiny helper or code snippet to add retries with exponential backoff and 429 handling around DocumentDB driver calls and embedding API calls. Looked in: documentdb-connection skill contains retry guidance but the sample author did not include a code snippet or helper in the repo. Effect: No retries are implemented; transient errors will cause exceptions or full fallback to in-memory ranking, reducing robustness of the demo when tested against a live cluster or rate-limited embedding provider.
proposed_change: [sample_or_quickstart] Add a small retry helper (e.g., using tenacity) to the agent kit and a one-line example in the sample: 'with retry_on_transient_errors(max_attempts=5): coll.aggregate(pipeline)'. Include special-case handling for 429 and respect Retry-After header.

topic: RU/provisioning mapping for authors
detail: Missing: A short page that explicitly states 'DocumentDB uses compute tiers and storage sizing for clusters (M10..M200). Do not use Cosmos DB RU assumptions.' and maps common Cosmos RU advice to the equivalent DocumentDB guidance. Looked in: readiness findings and quickstarts; searches returned Cosmos RU docs but no authoritative DocumentDB RU mapping. Effect: Risk of confusion when sample authors or agents try to apply Cosmos RU guidance and pick the wrong provisioning model.
proposed_change: [learn_doc] A one-page 'Provisioning model for DocumentDB' that contrasts Cosmos RU vs DocumentDB tiers, gives recommended dev defaults (M10), and shows a Bicep example with tier and storage parameters.

topic: Agent discoverability for 'do not return embeddings' guidance
detail: Missing: Although a vector-search example uses projection to omit embeddings (P20), a short explicit sentence in the public docs and agent-kit quickstarts encouraging authors not to return embeddings would reduce ambiguity for agents and builders. Looked in: learn.microsoft.com vector-search docs, sample READMEs; search results returned examples but not a short explicit rule targeted at sample authors. Effect: The sample does omit embeddings already, but explicit guidance would prevent accidental leakage in other samples.
proposed_change: [discoverability] Add a one-line rule in the vector-search quickstart: 'Never return raw vector values in API responses; project out embedding fields.'

topic: IVF numLists sizing
detail: Violated: When using IVF, choose numLists relative to dataset size (use documentCount/1000 for up to ~1M documents, and consider other index types like DiskANN beyond that); tune nProbes to trade recall for latency. Evidence: app/scripts/create_vector_index.py:27-31 (cosmosSearchOptions.options: {'nlist': 100}) — nlist=100 is not tuned relative to dataset size (demo has 5 documents).
proposed_change: Set a conservative demo default (e.g., nlist = min(32, max(1, document_count//1000))) or compute nlist from collection count; document the heuristic in the index script.

topic: Embedding storage type
detail: Violated: Store vectors as numeric arrays (number[]) so they can be indexed; embedding values stored as other types (for example raw BSON Binary) are not accepted by the vector index and will not be indexed. Evidence: app/scripts/load_data.py:79-83 (packs normalized float32 into Binary and sets doc['embedding'] = Binary(packed)); app/app.py uses Binary in searches (pack_embedding/unpack functions).
proposed_change: Store embeddings as a numeric array: doc['embedding'] = vec.tolist() (float32), and update create_vector_index/aggregation usage accordingly. Update README to warn builders that Binary-packed embeddings will not be indexed by cosmosSearch.

topic: Prefer Entra ID for auth
detail: Violated: Prefer Microsoft Entra ID (OIDC) + role-based access control for cluster authentication and management rather than embedding long-lived cluster passwords in code; Entra ID can be enabled as an auth mode on the cluster and you can register service principals or managed identities. Evidence: The sample uses MONGO_URI connection strings and .env.example; README does not document Entra ID usage or why it is not used in the demo.
proposed_change: Add a README section showing how to use Microsoft Entra ID (example with azure-identity and PyMongo MONGODB-OIDC) or state clearly why the sample uses connection-string auth for the quickstart.

topic: Retries & 429 handling
detail: Violated: Handle transient errors and rate limits with retries and exponential backoff, and treat HTTP 429 / rate-limiting specially (respect any Retry-After header and instrument throttling metrics). Evidence: app/app.py and scripts/load_data.py do not implement retries or exponential backoff around MongoClient operations or embedding API calls; the code catches exceptions but does not retry.
proposed_change: Add retry wrappers with exponential backoff (respect Retry-After for 429s) around db.command, coll.aggregate and OpenAI calls; consider using tenacity or similar retry libs.

topic: Verify index availability
detail: Violated: Verify index creation and availability before sending search traffic (make index creation idempotent and check listIndexes/getIndexes or createIndexes response). Evidence: app/scripts/create_vector_index.py prints the payload and attempts db.command but there is no code that verifies the index exists before the Flask app starts or prevents searches while index build/incompatibility exists. app/app.py relies on catching exceptions at query time and falling back to in-memory ranking (app/app.py:101-121, 122-146).
proposed_change: Modify create_vector_index.py to check getIndexes/listIndexes and block/return error until index is 'ready', or add an app startup check that refuses $search until index is present. Persist the admin payload if the gateway rejects the command.

topic: Binary artifacts & indexing
detail: Violated: If you choose to store embedding-related binary artifacts for non-index use (for example compact on-disk storage), document the serialization format and be aware that the DocumentDB vector index requires number[] for indexing so binary blobs won't be queryable by cosmosSearch. Evidence: app/scripts/load_data.py writes Binary(packed float32) (line 81). README.md:46 documents packing as 'BSON Binary (packed float32 little-endian)' but does not clearly say this will not be indexed by cosmosSearch.
proposed_change: Either store as number[] so server-side indexing works, or (if Binary is required) explicitly document the choice and note that such Binary embeddings will not be indexed by cosmosSearch (and give the alternative indexing approach).

detail: Cold answer was outdated (confused with legacy_vcore_naming). Deploy/automation would target the wrong resource shape.

detail: Cold answer was wrong (confused with azure_cosmos_db_for_mongodb_ru). No skill or doc in the inventory prescribes which approach to choose for this sample; I searched documentdb skills and quickstarts for session-store guidance and found none specific to agent-memory persistence.

topic: LlamaIndex Node integration guidance
detail: Missing: No public, discoverable guidance or agent-kit skill shows how to integrate LlamaIndex Node bindings with Azure DocumentDB's vector store (DiskANN) or provides a copy-paste adapter template. Looked in: Agent kit skills, Microsoft Learn vector-search docs, and run-time readiness notes (events.jsonl searches for LlamaIndex/Node bindings). This means the published sample does not demonstrate LlamaIndex usage the starter prompt requested.

topic: Index tuning defaults & copy-paste createIndexes
detail: Missing: A small copy-paste 'createIndexes' runCommand example with recommended DiskANN parameters for a sample-size catalog (10k) and a short explanation of recommended lBuild/lSearch values and their effect. Looked in: documentdb-vector-search skill and Microsoft Learn vector-search docs; the guidance exists but a ready-to-copy snippet for sample authors was not included in the local sample kit docs. Effect: The sample created a DiskANN index with defaults; runtime behaved, but authors and readers may not know which params to change for larger datasets.
proposed_change: [learn_doc] A short page named 'Sample: create DiskANN index for product catalog' containing the createIndexes runCommand JSON for DiskANN and suggested defaults for NUM_PRODUCTS=10k (e.g., lBuild=40, maxDegree=64) and recommended query-time lSearch values for k=10. Include a note on expected build time and memory.

topic: Embedding-model → index-dimension guidance
detail: Missing: Explicit examples mapping popular embedding models to index 'dimensions' and a recommended env var name convention for embedding model/dim pairs. Looked in: documentdb-vector-search skill, Microsoft Learn vector docs, readiness notes. Effect: Builder assumed text-embedding-3-small → 1536 dims; the run succeeded. Without explicit guidance, other authors may pick mismatched dims and silently corrupt nearest-neighbour behavior.
proposed_change: [discoverability] A brief table in the vector-search quickstart: 'Model name → default dims' (e.g., OpenAI text-embedding-3-small:1536, text-embedding-3-large:3072, etc.), and a note: 'Store embeddingModel and embeddingDims with each document; validate dims on ingest.'

topic: Session TTL index example
detail: Missing: A concrete example (code snippet) that creates a TTL index on the sessions collection (e.g., db.sessions.createIndex({ createdAt:1 }, { expireAfterSeconds: 3600 })). Looked in: documentdb-indexing skill and sample repo; skill documents TTL semantics but sample lacked the createIndex snippet. Effect: Sessions are persisted but there is no automatic expiry defined; long-term run could accumulate session documents.
proposed_change: [sample_or_quickstart] Add a short 'create session TTL index' snippet in seed.js (or README) that shows createIndex with expireAfterSeconds and explains the Date field requirement.

topic: Retry-and-throttle helpers
detail: Missing: A ready-to-use retry helper that honours Retry-After and applies exponential backoff/jitter for DocumentDB SDK calls and external embedding/LLM calls. Looked in: Throttling docs and documentdb-query-optimizer and connection skills; no packaged helper shipped in the agent kit for Node.js sample authors. Effect: Seed script uses batched insertMany but does not implement retries for 429s, increasing the risk of failed or partial ingestion under throttling.
proposed_change: [mcp_tool_or_description] Ship a small Node.js helper (retryWithBackoff) as part of the agent-kit or sample template showing how to inspect HTTP 429/Retry-After and how to backoff and retry DB and HTTP calls.

topic: Idempotent seeding and unique-index guidance
detail: Missing: A recommended pattern and a code snippet that: create unique indexes on productId, use bulkWrite upserts for idempotent seeds, and document how to re-run the seed safely. Looked in: documentdb-indexing skill and agent-kit samples; guidance present in pieces but not a one-shot snippet in the kit. Effect: The seed works but is not idempotent; repeated runs may create duplicates if unique indexes are not present or upsert not used.
proposed_change: [sample_or_quickstart] Add an 'idempotent seed' section to the seed example showing createIndex({productId:1},{unique:true}) and using bulkWrite with upsert:true to avoid duplicates.

topic: Guidance for using deterministic synthetic embeddings in tests
detail: Missing: Public guidance that explicitly recommends deterministic synthetic embeddings for CI and local dev when external embedding APIs are unavailable. Looked in: Searches for 'deterministic synthetic embeddings' returned no authoritative guidance (discovered_practices shows this as prior_knowledge_only). Effect: The builder implemented deterministic synthetic embeddings (good), but this is a prior-knowledge pattern that is not documented for Azure DocumentDB authors; agents may not automatically adopt the pattern.
proposed_change: [learn_doc] A short dev/testing guidance page: 'Testing vector apps without external APIs' that covers deterministic embeddings, seeding, and env flags to avoid external calls.

topic: Connection tuning
detail: Violated: Tune connection-pool parameters according to hosting: small maxPoolSize and short maxIdleTimeMS for serverless, larger pools (50+) and longer idle times for OLTP servers; set timeouts appropriate to expected latencies. Evidence: app/src/db.js line 35 sets maxPoolSize: 10 but no other tuning (connectTimeoutMS/socketTimeoutMS/maxIdleTimeMS) and no config-driven tuning for hosting was implemented.
proposed_change: Expose and document pool/timeouts in config (e.g., read MAX_POOL_SIZE, CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS, SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS from env) and set defaults per hosting guidance (serverless vs OLTP).

topic: Driver pinning
detail: listed_not_found: The driver version is pinned and is one the service supports.
proposed_change: A sentence in the driver or sample-kit README stating which driver minor/patch is tested and that package-lock.json must be committed.

topic: DiskANN tuning
detail: Violated: Prefer DiskANN for production-scale vector workloads on M30+ clusters and tune DiskANN build/query parameters (maxDegree, lBuild at index-build time; lSearch at query time) to trade recall vs latency. Evidence: app/src/seed.js creates a DiskANN index but does not set or expose build-time parameters like lBuild or maxDegree, nor does the server exposure allow tuning query-time lSearch. (Index created with default DiskANN params, seed.js lines 86-92.)
proposed_change: Expose DiskANN build parameters in seed config (ENV vars) and expose lSearch in query code so users can tune recall/latency; document expected defaults for the sample size and how to change them.

topic: Unique indexes / idempotent seed
detail: Violated: Use unique indexes to enforce uniqueness for primary keys used by the app (e.g., productId, sessionId) and use upserts carefully for idempotent seeding. Evidence: seed.js inserts products and orders with insertMany (app/src/seed.js lines 133-145, 150-166) but seed does not create unique index on productId or upsert logic; a repeated run may create duplicates if insertMany doesn't rely on _id uniqueness or if the collection's unique index isn't set.
proposed_change: Create a unique index on {productId:1} (and sessionId if used) and either use upsert or check-existence logic in the seed so the script is idempotent (e.g., bulkWrite with upsert:true).

topic: Embed metadata
detail: Violated: Store embedding metadata (model name, dims, embeddingVersion) with documents to detect mismatches and trigger re-embedding or index rebuilds when models change. Evidence: Seed stores embedding arrays on products (app/src/seed.js line 141) but does not persist embedding model metadata (EMBEDDING_MODEL/EMBEDDING_DIMS) alongside each document.
proposed_change: Persist metadata fields such as embeddingModel and embeddingDims on each product document at ingest time (e.g., { productId, title, embedding, embeddingModel: EMBEDDING_MODEL, embeddingDims: EMBEDDING_DIMS }).

topic: Validate vector dims
detail: Violated: When ingesting embeddings at scale, validate vector dimensions match the index and reject or normalize inconsistent vectors before inserting to avoid silent search corruption. Evidence: seed.js uses EMBEDDING_DIMS to shape synthetic embeddings (app/src/seed.js lines 20-21 and syntheticEmbedding lines 27-46), but does not validate that each produced embedding length matches EMBEDDING_DIMS before insert. There's no explicit per-document dims check.
proposed_change: Add a pre-insert check in seed.js that validates embedding.length === EMBEDDING_DIMS and rejects or pads/truncates inconsistent vectors with an explicit log/error.

topic: Retry semantics
detail: Violated: Enable SDK retry semantics and implement application-level retries with exponential backoff and jitter for transient errors and 429 responses, honoring Retry-After when present. Evidence: No retry wrapper for DocumentDB operations, nor a wrapper for OpenAI calls; seed.js uses insertMany and logs warnings on batch failures but does not inspect 429/Retry-After or implement exponential backoff and retry.
proposed_change: Wrap network/DB calls in a retry helper that honors Retry-After and uses exponential backoff with jitter; for bulk ingest, throttle concurrency and implement retries for 429 responses.

topic: Audit trail: seed counts
detail: Violated: Seed sizes and other hard choices should be recorded as a decision in decisions.jsonl for traceability (e.g., 10k products / 20k orders). Evidence: app/src/seed.js uses NUM_PRODUCTS=10000 and NUM_ORDERS=20000 but there is no corresponding decision recorded in decisions.jsonl for those numeric choices.
proposed_change: Add a decision entry for seeding sizes (e.g., 'I chose 10k products and 20k orders for the sample to balance realism and run time').

Binary vector storage also conflicts with the fetched service representation guidance. Looked in: requirements.md:12-17, prompt.md, prompt-review risks, vector skill and fetched vector page. Effect: Several reference misses measure an inconsistent fixture rather than shortcomings in the builder or public documentation.

topic: Pinned supported driver
detail: listed_not_found: The driver version is pinned and is one the service supports.

topic: Complete configuration example

proposed_change: A gallery configuration rule requiring all required inputs, placeholders, defaults, fixed settings, and secret handling to be inventoried together.

topic: Shard choice explanation
detail: listed_not_found: If the collection is sharded, the shard key choice is explained.
proposed_change: A gallery schema-design rule requiring a documented shard-key rationale whenever a sample shards collections.

topic: Transient failure retries
detail: Violated: Transient failures are retried in the way the service recommends. Evidence: app/src/database.js:17-18 enables read retries but disables write retries. app/src/ingestion.js:16,20,48-52 has no bounded application retry; app/scripts/seed.js:17-18 exits and asks for a manual rerun.
proposed_change: Wrap idempotent seed writes in bounded transient-only exponential-backoff retries with jitter. Do not blindly change retryWrites until the conflicting service guidance is reconciled.

topic: Service native infrastructure
detail: Violated: Infrastructure is defined as code using the service's own resource type, not a neighbouring service's. Evidence: No infrastructure artifact exists; app/README.md:18 requires an existing cluster. events.jsonl:91 logs this deliberate omission.
proposed_change: Include an optional parameterized cluster template without deploying it, or obtain an explicit gallery exception for existing-cluster-only samples.

topic: Complete sample README
detail: listed_not_found: The README states what the sample shows, prerequisites, setup, run and clean-up steps.
proposed_change: A gallery contribution page and agent-kit README template with those five mandatory sections.

topic: Documented command execution
detail: listed_not_found: The sample runs with the commands in the README.
proposed_change: A gallery verification contract requiring clean-machine installation, exact README-command tests, declared external prerequisites, and an authorized managed-DiskANN integration run.

topic: Offline test contract
detail: listed_not_found: Tests exist and pass without a live cloud resource, or the README says what they need.
proposed_change: A gallery testing rule and Node.js example using database/provider doubles, plus a separately gated live verifier.

topic: Pinned sample dependencies
detail: listed_not_found: Dependencies are pinned.
proposed_change: A gallery dependency rule requiring exact direct versions, a committed lockfile, supported runtime verification, and vulnerability review.

topic: Correct service naming
detail: listed_not_found: The sample names the service correctly and does not use a former or neighbouring product name.
proposed_change: A gallery naming rule distinguishing incorrect branding from legitimate disambiguation, retained URI/API/package names, and quoted historical guidance.

topic: DiskANN setup prerequisites
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Check cluster tier and service version for DiskANN support before index creation, failing clearly without substituting another index.
proposed_change: A DiskANN prerequisites table and read-only preflight tool returning target resource ID, tier, version, feature support and index permissions without secrets.

topic: Embedding input validation
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Use consistent embedding model/preprocessing and reject mismatched dimensions and nonfinite vector elements.
proposed_change: A vector-skill validation rule covering finite numeric values, exact dimensions, nonzero norm, model identity and identical ingestion/query preprocessing.

topic: Separate product order schemas
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Store one embedding-bearing document per product and purchase transactions separately, rather than treating every order as a searchable product.
proposed_change: A retail recommendation sample explaining product-level embeddings, bounded order baskets, distinct-order co-purchase semantics and why orders are not individual product vectors.

topic: Candidate pool reranking
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Overfetch candidates, exclude the input and duplicate IDs, apply co-purchase/session reranking, then select five.
proposed_change: A recommendation recipe defining candidate overfetch, exclusion, deduplication, reranking and insufficient-candidate behavior.

topic: Safe startup validation
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Validate URI configuration, await a bounded connect/ping, and distinguish missing, malformed, authentication and connectivity failures without exposing credentials.
proposed_change: A connection-skill startup contract with safe error categories, URI parsing, bounded connect/ping and credential-redaction tests.

topic: Universal timeout limits
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Set finite server-selection, connect and wait-queue timeouts and maxTimeMS on expensive queries.
proposed_change: A workload-specific timeout table covering sequential CLIs, ingestion/index builds and concurrent APIs, including when explicit query and queue limits are necessary.

topic: Deterministic seed upserts
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Use deterministic order IDs and updateOne/$setOnInsert upserts for repeatable transaction seeding.
proposed_change: A seed-script rule comparing replacement and insert-only upserts, deterministic IDs, interruption recovery and preservation of user-modified data.

topic: Distinct co purchase counting
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Match containing orders first and count each companion product at most once per order.
proposed_change: A tested co-purchase aggregation example with duplicate-line, quantity, anchor-exclusion and distinct-order semantics.

topic: Minimal recommendation context
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Project only ranking/explanation fields and exclude embeddings and raw orders from responses and LLM context.
proposed_change: An agent-sample privacy rule defining allowed provider context and explicitly excluding vectors, raw transactions and customer identifiers unless required and consented.

topic: Owned bounded session memory
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Use authenticated ownership or unguessable session IDs and bound memory history and lifetime.
proposed_change: A session-memory security guide separating local CLI labels from web/API sessions, with ownership checks, random IDs, retention and concurrency examples.

topic: Grounded recommendation explanations
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Ground explanations in retrieved attributes/counts/session preferences and validate returned IDs against ranked candidates.
proposed_change: An agent-output rule with fixed candidate membership, trusted-field merging, explanation evidence references and tests for fabricated purchases/preferences.

topic: Index drift readiness checks
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Use idempotent setup comparing existing index definitions and verify vector readiness before recommendations.
proposed_change: A vector setup rule with normalized definition comparison, drift errors, bounded readiness probing and explicit permission requirements.

topic: Embedding lifecycle metadata
detail: prior_knowledge_only: Persist model identity/version and source-content hash, regenerating embeddings when source content or model changes.
proposed_change: An embedding lifecycle page specifying source hashes, provider/model revision identifiers, normalization versions, cache invalidation and deliberate index rebuilds.

topic: Measured DiskANN search tuning
detail: Violated: Keep k <= lSearch and tune lSearch within 10–1000 against measured recall and latency. Evidence: app/src/repository.js:50 correctly uses k=30/lSearch=40, but app/README.md:127 and the execution trace provide no measured tuning.
proposed_change: Retain the legal defaults for the demo, add a representative recall/latency benchmark, and document how to adjust lSearch while maintaining k <= lSearch.

topic: Measured DiskANN build tuning
detail: Violated: Tune maxDegree and lBuild on representative data rather than assuming defaults meet accuracy/build-cost requirements. Evidence: app/src/repository.js:8 uses 32/50; app/README.md:9 states the values without measurements or scaling instructions.
proposed_change: Label these as unbenchmarked teaching defaults and add a tuning procedure measuring recall, build time and resource usage on representative catalogs.

topic: Vector eligibility prefiltering
detail: Violated: When filtering vector candidates, place eligibility predicates inside cosmosSearch.filter and index the filtered properties. Evidence: app/src/repository.js:50,82 applies anchor and metadata exclusions after ANN retrieval. The deliberate overfetch makes this defensible for the tiny homogeneous catalog, but it differs from public prefilter guidance.
proposed_change: Push anchor eligibility into cosmosSearch.filter using the existing _id index. If supporting mixed-model catalogs, prefilter model metadata with the corresponding standard indexes rather than filtering after top-k.

topic: Decision persistence integrity
detail: Violated: Persist distinct decision records without losing previously logged choices. Evidence: events.jsonl:83-92 returns 'Recorded as D002' for ten distinct choices; decisions.jsonl retains only D002 and D002b. events.jsonl:100-101 then records logger exceptions. Index/auth/model choices were logged in events, not silently made.
proposed_change: Fix unique-ID allocation and atomic append/validation in log_decision; recover distinct event-backed decisions with provenance rather than attributing the loss to the builder.

topic: Unlogged package registry choice
detail: Violated: Record environment-specific package-registry choices that affect sample reproducibility. Evidence: app/package-lock.json:22,36,47,60 pins tarball URLs to the runner's ms-feed-25.pkgs.visualstudio.com feed; no decision explains public portability of this registry choice.
proposed_change: Document and verify anonymous clean-machine access to the pinned feed, or regenerate and review the lockfile using the intended public registry. Log the publishing choice.

topic: Dependency security verification
detail: listed_not_found: Resolve or explicitly assess reported dependency vulnerabilities before publication.
proposed_change: A gallery security gate and an available dependency-audit tool returning advisory details, affected paths, compatible remediation options and exceptions.

topic: A .env.example lists every setting with placeholder values.
detail: partly_met because skill_silent. app/.env.example:3-4 lists both environment inputs. Database, models, dimensions, and embedding version remain fixed settings in app/src/config.js:3-9 rather than appearing in that inventory.
proposed_change: Add a sample-packaging rule: inventory every setting, distinguish fixed defaults from configurable environment inputs, and include placeholders for every required input.

topic: The vector index parameters are chosen for the catalog size, and the README says how to change them for a larger one.
detail: partly_met because skill_silent. app/src/catalog.js:11-22 defines 60 products; app/src/repository.js:7-8,50 uses default-like DiskANN values. app/README.md:7-10 states values but gives no larger-catalog tuning procedure or measurements.
proposed_change: Extend the vector skill with a gallery rule requiring a README tuning section: catalog vector count, default rationale, representative recall/latency measurements, and where to change maxDegree, lBuild, k, and lSearch.
